visual_action: Donald Trump, in a dark suit, stands in an ornate, gold-trimmed arched doorway of a stone building. He walks down a short flight of steps. Another man in a dark suit approaches him from the left. They speak briefly, Trump gestures with his right hand, and then they shake hands, posing for a moment. The scene then cuts to a series of black-and-white still photos: the front of the White House, a helicopter (likely Marine One), and another shot of the White House, all with a logo overlaid. An American flag is visible on a flagpole to the left of the doorway in the first scene. A doormat reads 'The Mar-a-Lago Club'.
